finding: Parity is decided by the dependency critical path, not by node_sum or overlap mass. tinygrad's critical path alone is longer than llama's entire graph span, so no amount of queue overlap can close the wall gap; the dependency structure itself must be relaxed.

reframing: The next lever is not more queues or better overlap of already-independent nodes. It is shortening tinygrad's critical path by moving flash, reduce_output, and residual support off the dependency chain, matching the edges llama uses to keep its support behind the mmq chain.
